summary: Twelve connected later-campaign source-context repairs: retain existing AD346 one-sided bounds and make their narrative basis explicit. Partial uninstalled proposal; no date approval.

sourceDate.text: Suo Xia’s rites debate, appointment and remonstrance in Chonghua’s reign after 永和二年 accession (s0499, s0539–s0591); exact event years unstated

after.event: Suo Xia debated mourning rites, later remonstrated when Chonghua slackened in government, and served as army corrector.

changes.reason: s0539 identifies Suo Xia in the rites debate begun with 是月 at s0537. s0573 names him advising Chonghua against personal advance and s0577 appoints him army corrector. s0582 explains Chonghua’s slackening by repeated victories; s0583 司直索遐諫 and s0591’s answer continue that current reign. These linked acts belong to Suo Xia himself after Chonghua’s s0499 accession, supporting the existing onOrAfter AD346 bound. The cited 魯宣三年 in his rites speech dates an ancient precedent, not his speaking; 經旬積朔 and 曆月 express elapsed delays, not numbered calendar years. No exact year or upper endpoint is imported.

changes.reason: s0543 重華從之 accepts the rites advice; s0560 and s0577 issue commands and s0570 rewards the victory before the renewed attack in s0571. s0582 links his later neglect to these repeated victories, while s0591 records his unamended response to Suo Xia. s0594 sends troops after Wang Zhuo’s flight and s0597 records mourning for the resulting defeat. No later numbered year, closed campaign interval or reign-end endpoint appears; the broad claim remains a sequence of distinct acts without forcing them into one year.

after.event: Wang Zhuo raided Jinxing and Guangwu, fled after defeat at Shenniao, later fled to Chonghua after Fu Xiong broke him, then attacked Fu Jian and later took Qinzhou.

changes.reason: s0571 names Wang Zhuo as Ma Qiu’s raider; s0580 names his defeat at Shenniao after the command in s0577. s0593 是時 names his later defeat by Fu Xiong and flight to Chonghua; s0594 appoints and dispatches him, s0596 records his defeat, and s0598 復授擢兵 orders another attack that takes Qinzhou. The repeated name and explicit current ruler connect all these distinct actions to Chonghua’s post-s0499 reign. Retain only the existing onOrAfter AD346 floor, without treating 是時 or 復 as an exact year or supplying a latest endpoint.
